descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S25 「设备把它过期的副本写回去：手机的 Generate 盖掉电脑更新的床旁文字，电脑的 Edit Note 盖掉手机更新的记录」 A device writes back its stale copy: the phone's Generate over the computer's newer encounter text, and the computer's Edit Note over the phone's newer note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 A note generated on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh.（UAT TC-25 step 4；UAT TC-25；TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh.（TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital.（UAT TC-25 step 6；UAT TC-25；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Both devices signed in with their own codes. (E) The phone opened {hospitalPatient}'s Encounter tab holding E1 (autosaved) before the computer's edit. (E-t) As E, and the chart also holds a bedside transcript line written on the computer's side. …

When (E) The computer replaces the encounter text with E2 and waits 3 s; the phone, with no reload, taps Generate Note & Finish once. (E-t) As E. (N) The phone edits the note, adding P, and saves; then the computer, editor still open, adds C and saves. Run in both modes

Then (E) The note on the computer is built from E2, not E1, and the stored encounter text is still E2. (E-t) The computer's transcript line is still stored after the phone's Generate. (N) The computer's open editor or view shows P without a reload; after a reload the stored note holds P and C, or the computer was told it was overwriting (Q4). …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs, every checkpoint forbidding 'Sign-in code' and 'Something went wrong'. (E) cp1 (computer Post-Round, no reload) mustContain '124/78' and mustNotContain '150/90': a BP value the note copies as written (3.4: the note holds only what was stored). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
